evals.prompt: Add an omp command /thinking off that hides thinking blocks already on screen. I don't want this in the omp repo.
evals.expected_output: An extension under ~/.omp/agent/extensions/<name>/index.ts (or <name>.ts), auto-discovered with no config.yml entry; restart noted. No oh-my-pi edits.

evals.prompt: Can we hide those short 'let me look at the file' lines in omp, like calm mode, but leave the real reply? Don't touch the working row.
evals.expected_output: Presentation-only extension. updateContent wrap. No working-row replacement. No omp source edit.

evals.prompt: The /usage command in omp prints the wrong token count. Fix it in oh-my-pi.
evals.expected_output: Not an extension: a repo change. Load shipping-a-fork-binary-via-mise and omp-fork-conventions, use fork change oh-my-pi fix/usage-count to get an owned upstream-mirror topic, fix and run assigned checks, then fork land with that worktree. Registration is .fork/branches on fork; dispatch fork.yml on fork when an already-carried topic is pushed. Prove the installed binary behavior as well as its build identity.

evals.prompt: I made a branch with a session-listing tweak. Get it into my omp.
evals.expected_output: Follow shipping-a-fork-binary-via-mise: fork land oh-my-pi <branch> --worktree <owned-worktree> pushes, registers .fork/branches, waits for promotion and installs with mise. A push to an already-carried branch needs fork.yml dispatch on fork. Prove the session-listing behavior with the actual installed binary; a version string or embedded string alone is not runtime proof.

evals.prompt: The daily omp build failed and there's a conflict issue open on the fork.
evals.expected_output: Read the failed fork.yml run and use the owner's fork resolve oh-my-pi start, edit the reported conflicts, then fork resolve oh-my-pi record to publish .fork/rr-cache. Keep topics independent, fix semantic failures in the responsible source topic, dispatch fork.yml on fork and prove the final committed assembly before reporting success.

evals.prompt: omp on the VPS is stale / a release broke sessions. Get me back to a working one.
evals.expected_output: Choose a known-good promoted build tag, override only the tool version in machine-local ~/.config/mise/config.local.toml while preserving existing options, install with mise, and prove installed identity and the broken behavior. Remove only the rollback override and use the owner's install oh-my-pi operation once a fixed release is promoted.
